Do not restart existing systems or widen this task into full art/content/campaign production.

Complete these three related pieces, then return a committed interface checkpoint:

1. **Immediate command/save coherence (R1).** Reproduce and fix `fixtureGame → executeCommand(carrier helm) → encodeSave` without a tick: root observes valid before / invalid after, player/hull pose distance 7.2111 m. Also fix a valid disabled Dart → local tow → field repair before a tick: the repaired hull remains the target of an active recovery operation and cannot be saved. Exercise helm/leave helm, station keeping, repair during tow, interruption/cancellation and related command outcomes through the real command/save seams. Commands exposed while menus stop ticks must leave complete serializable state. Keep strict validation; do not conceal invalid states by weakening ownership rules or auto-advancing time during save.
2. **Minimal physical carrier corridor (R3).** Define one authoritative, simple carrier-local description of isolated dry berths, transfer/launch lock and whole capture/launch route, using existing production collision authority. Validate the craft's entire swept envelope, not just a clear endpoint, before preparation and again before committing. Cover both compact slots and the medium configuration; an obstruction between a clear berth and clear endpoint, a later obstruction, interruption and capture must preserve identity/cargo/charge/damage. Preserve Spindle's surface launch and the other dry berth, stationary interior walking, supported empty reconfiguration and exactly-once transfer. No fluid simulation or underway walking. Freeze dimensions/frames and provide descriptors the visual worker can consume. Keep any actual rendered changes minimal and necessary for coherence; final visual polish and browser fixture matrix are later bounded work.
3. **Sound-event origin seam (R5).** Add the smallest unsaved event metadata that distinguishes spatial threat warnings from nonspatial body/equipment alarms. Update producers and the audio consumer coherently; only actual spatial cues should pan to their origin. Keep captions/visual information aligned, existing activation/volume/mute lifecycle and no new dependency. No wholesale audio redesign.

## Contracts and compatibility

Retain one registry, plain serializable state, metres/Y-up/world versus carrier-local frames, capsule-base player reference and existing scene lifecycle callbacks. Existing seams already support separate graphics and presentation owners; do not perform a general extraction. Persistent provenance text is validated exactly and is not ordinary copyediting. The current provisional schema is 2 / `expedition.2`; preserve old records and explicitly propose a migration/content-version policy if geometry or state changes make prior valid saves incompatible. Do not silently reject all provisional saves or alter physical placement without a reason and visible migration feedback.

Return exact signatures and authoritative dimensions, events, fields and validator changes. Main keeps registry/types/world/save/runtime ownership after this task; root must reconcile and commit the new shared baseline before specialists start. Any new art-only descriptor should derive from the same physical data rather than duplicate numbers inside renderer/save modules.

Use focused red/green reproduction for the two confirmed command failures and intervening-corridor obstruction. Test the changed event semantics and affected app/menu/save boundaries. Run `npm run check` and `node scripts/check-m1-economy.mjs`; retain check output and final source/bundle identity. Update migration fixtures if needed; no full M0 browser-matrix rerun.
